entries.name: stop
entries.summary: Number of this stop within the run, starting at 1.

entries.name: now
entries.summary: Game time in milliseconds since the run started.

entries.name: information_level
entries.summary: How much of the line this scenario lets the policy see.

entries.name: train
entries.summary: The train that has stopped.

entries.name: id
entries.summary: Train id, as written in the scenario.

entries.name: direction
entries.summary: Direction the train will leave in. `forward` runs towards the last station; trains reverse at either end.

entries.name: speed
entries.summary: Distance travelled per second.

entries.name: capacity
entries.summary: How much the train can carry.

entries.name: shared
entries.summary: Total milli-units across all resources, when capacity is shared.

entries.name: per_resource
entries.summary: Milli-units per resource id, when capacity is per resource.

entries.name: cargo
entries.summary: Milli-units carried, by resource id. Every scenario resource is present.

entries.name: space
entries.summary: Milli-units more the train could load, by resource id.

entries.name: memory
entries.summary: Persistent table for this train, under the same rules as `ctx.memory`.

entries.name: station
entries.summary: The station the train has stopped at. Its stock and capacity are always readable.

entries.name: id
entries.summary: Station id, as written in the scenario.

entries.name: index
entries.summary: Position on the line, starting at 1.

entries.name: resources
entries.summary: Ids of the resources this station stores, in scenario order.

entries.name: distance_to_next
entries.summary: Distance to the next station; `nil` on the last station.

entries.name: stock
entries.summary: Milli-units stored, by resource id. Readable for other stations only at the `line` level.

entries.name: capacity
entries.summary: Storage limit in milli-units, by resource id. Readable for other stations only at the `line` level.

entries.name: memory
entries.summary: Persistent table for this station, under the same rules as `ctx.memory`. Present on `ctx.station`.

entries.name: line
entries.summary: The stations on the line, in order.

entries.name: stations
entries.summary: Stations in line order.

entries.name: id
entries.summary: Station id, as written in the scenario.

entries.name: index
entries.summary: Position on the line, starting at 1.

entries.name: resources
entries.summary: Ids of the resources this station stores, in scenario order.

entries.name: distance_to_next
entries.summary: Distance to the next station; `nil` on the last station.

entries.name: stock
entries.summary: Milli-units stored, by resource id. Readable for other stations only at the `line` level.

entries.name: capacity
entries.summary: Storage limit in milli-units, by resource id. Readable for other stations only at the `line` level.

entries.name: memory
entries.summary: Persistent table for this station, under the same rules as `ctx.memory`. Present on `ctx.station`.

entries.name: distance
entries.summary: Distance along the line between two stations.

params.name: from
params.summary: Station id, as written in the scenario.

params.name: to
params.summary: Station id, as written in the scenario.

entries.name: travel_time
entries.type: fun(from: string, to: string, speed?: integer): integer
entries.summary: Milliseconds a train takes between two stations, not counting stops. Uses the stopped train's speed when `speed` is omitted.

params.name: from
params.summary: Station id, as written in the scenario.

params.name: to
params.summary: Station id, as written in the scenario.

params.name: speed
params.summary: Distance per second.

entries.name: resources
entries.summary: Every resource in the scenario, in scenario order.

entries.name: id
entries.summary: Resource id, such as `Metals`.

entries.name: priority
entries.summary: Weight used when scoring unmet demand; higher is more important.

entries.name: memory
entries.summary: Table kept between calls for the whole run. It may hold only booleans, numbers, strings and tables of those, without cycles.

entries.name: rand
entries.summary: A number from 0 up to but not including 1, repeatable for the same seed.

entries.name: load
entries.summary: Move `amount` milli-units of `resource` from the station onto the train. Clamped to what the station holds and the train can carry.

params.name: resource
params.summary: Resource id, such as `Metals`.

params.name: amount
params.summary: Milli-units to load; 1 unit is 1000.

entries.name: unload
entries.summary: Move `amount` milli-units of `resource` from the train into the station. Clamped to what the train carries and the station can store.

params.name: resource
params.summary: Resource id, such as `Metals`.

params.name: amount
params.summary: Milli-units to unload; 1 unit is 1000.

entries.name: log
entries.summary: Attach a message to this stop. Arguments are converted to text and joined with spaces.

params.summary: Values to write.

entries.name: record
entries.summary: Add a point to a named series that is charted after the run.

params.name: name
params.summary: Series name.

params.name: value
params.summary: Finite number to record.

entries.name: policy
entries.type: fun({ classify?: Block|function, target: Block|function|table<string, Block|function>, plan?: Block|function, allocate?: Block|function })
entries.summary: Builds a policy from stages: classify, target, plan and allocate. Only target is required. Returns a policy module.

params.name: classify
params.summary: Gives each site a role. Without it every site has the role any.

params.name: target
params.summary: The stock each site should have, as one block or a table of blocks by role.

params.name: plan
params.summary: Keeps cargo for stations further along and reserves it.

params.name: allocate
params.summary: Shares limited train space between resources. Without it actions go out site by site.

entries.name: roles.manual
entries.summary: Assigns the roles supply, demand, relay or any by station, for every resource or per resource.

params.name: assignments
params.summary: Roles by station id, such as { Mine = "supply", Dome = { Food = "demand" } }.

entries.name: balance
entries.summary: Targets the average stock of the resource across the stations that store it, as the naive baseline does.

entries.name: order_up_to
entries.summary: Targets a fixed level.

params.name: level
params.summary: Stock to aim for, in milli-units.

entries.name: min_max
entries.summary: Raises the site to max when its inventory position falls below min, and otherwise leaves it alone.

params.name: min
params.summary: Inventory position below which the site is refilled, in milli-units.

params.name: max
params.summary: Level to refill to, in milli-units.

entries.name: drain
entries.summary: Targets zero, so trains take everything they can.

entries.name: fill
entries.summary: Targets the site's capacity, so trains leave everything they can.

entries.name: pass_through
entries.summary: Makes no transfers at the site.

entries.name: lookahead
entries.summary: Serves the station a train is at first, then keeps and reserves cargo for shortfalls further along. At supply sites, loads only what is needed ahead.

entries.name: priority
entries.summary: Gives limited train space to higher priority resources first.

entries.name: proportional
entries.summary: Shares limited train space in proportion to what each resource asks for.

entries.name: inventory_position
entries.type: fun(ctx: StopContext, station: string, resource: string)
entries.summary: Stock at a station plus cargo other trains have reserved for it. For use in custom functions.

params.name: ctx
params.summary: The context passed to on_stop.

params.name: station
params.summary: Station id.

params.name: resource
params.summary: Resource id.
